title: workspace.member_password_reset
description: An organization administrator reset a member's password (#110). The org-side audit record of the action — what a workspace-scoped activity log reads; auth writes its own AuthAuditLog row for the same act with the same actor, and the two are meant to agree. Carries NO credential material: the event fans out to every subscriber, while the generated password goes to exactly one place, the ordering admin's HTTP response, exactly once.
